brief: Shells a piece of QML out to Qt's standalone qml runtime as a child process, and captures its output and duration.
detail: Write the QML with SetCode, run it with Execute (which writes temp/temp.qml and starts the runtime) and read what it printed with Result. It keeps the library free of any Qt binding: the runtime is found by the name qml, by $aStzLibConfig[:QmlPath] or by SetQmlPath. It does not read an exit code, and IsRuntimeAvailable only checks that a path is configured. Use new stzQmlCode() with parentheses so that Init creates the temp folder. A QML view opens a window: the qml runtime is not installed on the machine of this documentation run, so Execute was exercised only against a path that does not exist.
